description: Home base for me and for this campaign. Dubois County is where I learned that showing up, pulling the records, and asking for a vote can actually move a county government. This district is bigger than my home county. The promise on all six pages is the same: whoever is closest to a decision gets heard first.

title: Dubois County | Brad Hochgesang for State Senate
